simple.meaning: יָצִיא (yâtsîyʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “issue , i.e. offspring.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Chronicles 32:21. The surrounding context includes family line, death, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָצִיא (H3329) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H3329. yatsi [ יָצִיא ] adjective coming forth ; only with מִן and suffix, מֵעָיו ומיציאו 2Chr 32:21 Kt ( וּמִיצִיאֵי Qr), and some of those who came forth from his loins ( בניו in || Isa 37:38 ).

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, and the leaders and captains, in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body* i.e., his own sons killed him there with the sword.
